notes.title: Multi-language Support Added !!!
notes.content:
Greetings players!
We want to let you know that we added Multi-language support for 13 different languages, specifically:


 Chinese Simplified
 Chinese Traditional
 French	
 German
 Greek			
 Italian
 Japanese
 Korean
 Polish
 Portuguese
 Russian
 Spanish
 Turkish


If you notice any problems, make a thread on the official forums, and we will get back to you.
Happy Playing !!

notes.title: Cross-Platform Online Co-op Now Available !!!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce our Major Update v.0.2.0.0 !!!
We bring you Cross-Platform Online Co-Op!
Now you can play from Windows, Linux, and Mac (oSX) with your friends!

Major Update v 2.0.0.0 Changelog

Online

 Cross Platform Online Mode Added you can now play with your friends from Windows, Linux, and Mac(Osx).


Gameplay

 Added 1 New World (Water World) with 5 new levels.


Physics

 Changed how physics worked for gameplay.


Music

 Added Main Theme Song
 Added The Floor is Lava Song.
 Added 5 another songs.


Bugs

 Fixed All kinds of Bugs.

notes.title: Update v 0.1.1.2
notes.content:
Gameplay

 Implemented Swimming System to be used in Water World.
 Implemented Oxygen System to be used in Water World.


UI

 Changed Customization Screen to display or hide Keyboard and Gamepad icons properly.
 Mac Os: Fixed Joystick support for Xbox Controller to be properly recognized.


Bugs

 Fixed Small UI Bugs.
